title: Bound on the total size of a gate's children
statement: Let $g = \mathrm{node}\,(\mathit{isAnd},\, cs)$ be an internal gate of a Boolean circuit on $n$ variables, with $cs$ the list of its child subcircuits, and let $s$ be a natural number with $\mathrm{size}(g) \le s$. Then the sum of the sizes of the children, $\sum_{c \in cs} \mathrm{size}(c)$, is at most $s - 1$ (truncated natural-number subtraction).
hypotheses_covered: g is an internal gate node(isAnd, cs) on n variables
the gate has size at most s
replaced:
If a node circuit $\mathrm{node}\,\mathit{isAnd}\,cs$ has size at most $s$, then the sum of
the sizes of its children is at most $s - 1$.
